title: Place canonical HDDHub PNGs in frontend/public and ensure HDDHub layers resolve them

requirements.summary: Create frontend/public (if missing) and add the five canonical PNG assets so existing ASSET_PATHS/fallback chains can load them.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/` exists in the repository after the change.
The five canonical files `bg.png`, `vinyl.png`, `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, `arm.png` exist directly under `frontend/public/` (not nested).
On a fresh build/preview, the background and HDD hub images load without 404s when viewing the deployed site.

requirements.summary: Constrain changes to the three selected HDDHub elements while ensuring they render the canonical body/disk/arm public assets via the existing fallback chains.
acceptanceCriteria: In the rendered UI, the HDD body, platter, and arm are visibly present (not missing/transparent placeholders) when the canonical PNGs are available.
Browser network tab shows successful loads (200) for `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, and `arm.png` from the deployed base path (no root-absolute `/bodyhdd.png` style breakage on subpaths).
No other, non-selected elements are modified as part of this change.

file_operations.description: Update only the three selected elements (HDD body, disk, arm layers) to add minimal, non-styling attributes (e.g., identifiers for verification) while keeping their src values bound to the existing hddBodyFallbacks/hddDiskFallbacks/hddArmFallbacks chains so they resolve to the canonical public assets when present.
